sources.title: Mistral 7B • LM Studio
sources.snippet: Mistral 7B Instruct v0.3 by mistralai Version 0.3 has a few changes over release 0.2, including: An extended vocabulary (32000 → 32768) A new tokenizer Support for function calling Function calling support is made possible through the new extended vocabulary, including tokens TOOL_CALLS, AVAILABLE_TOOLS, and TOOL_RESULTS. This model maintains the v0.2 context length of 32768
